interpretation: INAE3000 is the official current-item lookup and weekly freshness source.
The response schema directly carries product identifiers and ATC codes, with reimbursement-rule references where present.
Rule-to-ATC remains a derived projection through supporting product rows and must not be represented as whole-class legal applicability.
The monthly IODE immutable CSV remains the clean-room rebuild baseline; this paginated API does not replace it.
